title: The Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array Spectroscopic Survey in the Hubble Ultra Deep Field: CO Emission Lines and 3 mm Continuum Sources
question: How to reliably search for emission lines and continuum sources in the ASPECS-LP 3 mm cube, and what are the resulting CO line and 3 mm continuum samples and 3 mm number counts

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 3.8 uJy/beam in deepest region

what.value: ASPECS-Pilot band 3 data and source list for comparison

evidence.quote: The details about the ASPECS-Pilot observations were presented in (cite: Walter2016)

what.value: 1.1 mm number counts compiled for extrapolation to 3 mm

evidence.quote: We make use of the results obtained by (cite: Franco2018), which takes the number counts of several published studies

what.value: 3 mm number counts from ALMA archive for comparison

evidence.quote: We also compare our number counts with the observed 3 mm number counts presented by (cite: Zavala2018).

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image 3 mm cube and continuum
recipe.method: Pipeline plus own scripts; tclean natural weighting, per-channel beams, 7.813 MHz channels; continuum by collapsing all channels
Run LineSeeker, FindClump, MF3D on simulated cubes with injected lines and on real cube; compare S/N
key_parameters: Gaussian kernel sigma_GK 0-19 (LineSeeker); top-hat N=1-9 (FindClump); spatial kernels FWHM 0-4'' (MF3D)

recipe.method: Fidelity = 1 - N_neg/N_pos using negative lines per kernel; erf function fit to negative S/N histogram; select Fidelity>=0.9
assumptions: Negative lines are produced by noise only; noise symmetric around 0

recipe.method: Inject 5000 Gaussian point-source lines (50 per iteration) into real cube; recovered if Fidelity>=0.9; for continuum inject 10,000 point sources, recovered at S/N>=4.6

recipe.goal: Characterise detected lines and identify transitions
recipe.method: Gaussian profile fit with MCMC to PB-corrected spectra; resolved if voxel S/N>=2 flux >=10% above central; identify via NIR counterpart redshifts

recipe.goal: Derive 3 mm number counts and compare with extrapolations
recipe.method: N(S_i)=(1/A) sum P_i/C_i with bins of 0.25 dex in logS, fidelity and PB-corrected completeness; compare with synchrotron extrapolations and 1.1 mm counts scaled to 3 mm
assumptions: Modified blackbody, beta=1.5-2.0, T=25-40 K, z=2.5, CMB effects

answer_key.quantity: Number of emission lines with Fidelity>=0.9

evidence.quote: We present all the 16 emission–line candidates for which the condition of ${\rm Fidelity}\geq0.9$ is fulfilled.

answer_key.quantity: Number of continuum sources with Fidelity>=0.9

evidence.quote: We identified six continuum source candidates with a ${\rm Fidelity}\geq0.9$.
the ratio between the S/N obtained with FindClump and LineSeeker is of $1.00^{+0.06}_{-0.04}$

evidence.loc: 5.1 The distribution of emission line widths
evidence.quote: the secure positive lines have a flat FWHM distribution and a median value of $\approx331{{\rm \thinspace km\thinspace s}^{-1}}$

answer_key.quantity: Mean beta of continuum sources (T=35 K)

evidence.quote: average value $\beta=1.6\pm0.2$ obtained for our continuum sources when assuming a dust temperature of 35 K

not_stated_but_needed: Number and settings of LineSeeker S/N thresholds and DBSCAN parameters
tclean cell size, image size and mask details
Flux calibrators and flux scale uncertainty
MCMC sampler, priors and likelihood for Gaussian line fits
Which channels removed for continuum image
Dust SED extrapolation code and details for number counts
score_reason: Public data and public LineSeeker code with detailed method, but imaging and calibration details are sparse and rely on companion papers.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the search recipe is described and the results (line and continuum source lists, counts) are numeric.
